pool.text: First Malay traders expelled from Melaka began making this port their trading base.
The 9th King of Gowa allied with the nearby trade-oriented polity of Tallo.
Karaeng Matoaya guided the young ruler through the acceptance of Islam in Makassar.
The first official Friday Prayer in the city was traditionally dated.
The English East India Company established a trading post in Makassar.
The Danish Company arrived to establish a presence in Makassar.
Makassar became the most extensive Portuguese base in Southeast Asia after Dutch conquest.
A new king rejected the alliance with Tallo after Pattingalloang died.
The Dutch VOC seized the chance to conquer the northern Makassar fort.
The Dutch conquered and destroyed Sombaopu in one of the greatest battles.
French explorers saw a fleet of Macassan perahus on the Holothuria Banks.
The population of Makassar reached around eighty-four thousand residents.
The Japanese landed near Makassar during the wartime military campaign.
Indonesia proclaimed its Independence, altering the political status of the region.
The Makassar Uprising took place, resulting in integration into the republic.
The city was renamed after a variant of the pre-colonial fort name.
The name of the city officially reverted to Makassar under the president.
A radio documentary on the historical trade was made for the national broadcaster.
The Sangkarrang Islands District was created to cover the small islands.
The population of Makassar City reached approximately one point four eight million.
